Count.description: A count given as a number or as a word such as `auto`.

description: The `[tool.muru.serve]` table (`[serve]` in muru.toml), and the file `MURU_SERVE_CONFIG` names: how `muructl serve` runs the application in a container. A key is a flag of the command in snake case, taking the flag's value; a list key takes the values the flag would be repeated with.

access_log_exclude.description: Paths left out of the access log.

admin_listen.description: Where the probes and metrics are served, IP:PORT or `off`.

admin_status.description: Whether `/status` is served on the admin port.

concurrency.description: Requests an ASGI worker's event loop takes at once.

factory.description: Whether the entrypoint is a factory.

hooks.description: The module providing the lifecycle hooks.

listen.description: Where the application is served, IP:PORT.

log_format.description: The lines on standard output: `text` (the default), or `json` for a log collector.

max_connections_per_client.description: Connections one client may have open.

max_lifetime.description: How long a worker lives before it is replaced.

max_requests.description: Requests a worker serves before it is replaced.

min_ready.description: The workers ready in every worker group for `/readyz` to pass.

preload.description: Whether the application is imported before the workers are forked: `auto`, `true` or `false`.

processes.description: Worker processes, or `auto` for the container's CPU limit, else the CPU count.

python.description: The interpreter: a path, or a request in uv's syntax. When absent, `/app/.venv` if there is no `VIRTUAL_ENV` and no project `.venv`, else the interpreter `muructl run` would find.

run_dir.description: Where everything written at run time goes.

runtime_dir.description: Where the image holds the runtime library.

shutdown_budget.description: How long the whole stop may take, the delay included.

shutdown_delay.description: How long the listener keeps accepting after SIGTERM, readiness failing, with every connection closing after its response.

slow.description: How slow a request is to count as an error for `access_log = "errors"`.

spool_quota.description: The most request bodies spooled to disk at once.

sync_threads.description: Threads for synchronous code called from an ASGI application.

timeout.description: Timeouts as NAME=DURATION, as `--timeout` takes them.

timestamps.description: Whether every line carries the full UTC time.

trusted_proxy.description: The proxies whose forwarding headers are applied: addresses, CIDR ranges, or loopback, private and unix.
